# Subscribe to Podcast

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Subscribes to the Podcast at the given feed url in Apple Podcasts.

## Syntax

~~~~text
subscribeToPodcast(feedURL: <#Array#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
subscribeToPodcast(feedURL: https://atp.fm/rss)
~~~~
